arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Original photos 1 N19 and 2 N29 control Neet; photos 3 B29 and 4 B04 control Buddy. Final image is BODY FINISH ONLY reference, no anatomy or scene transfer. Neet small full narrow fawn torso, fine legs, huge broad triangular ears, tiny flush nub, very SHORT SMOOTH coat. Buddy moderately elongated full charcoal torso, visible neck and substantial legs with clearance, pale distal legs, regional furnished cream muzzle/brows and hanging ears only. Smooth unengraved flat washes on torsos, no curls, shag, engraved fur lines. Four owned limbs each with plausible support. Restrictions N35 excluded anatomy, B08 styling only unused, B25 unavailable, B30 supplemental rest unused; B04/B24 one exposure. Humans provisional. No text, balloons or costumes. DRAW a four-panel pencil staging storyboard, landscape 2x2 panels with white gutters. It is construction planning, not finished art. Each panel separate complete composition, dogs on slack leashes visibly clipped to neck collars. Panel upper left: sidewalk twilight bouquet scene, cropped Heather hand holds colorful five-type flower bouquet just above Buddy's upward nose, his mouth slightly open; Neet stands separate watching. Panel upper right: wide view German shepherd confrontation: much larger normal shepherd at right restrained by cropped woman holding leash, Neet barking forward at left, Buddy behind Neet turned homeward toward left; Sagar's cropped legs behind small dogs. Everyone spatially separate. Panel lower left: later blue twilight, Buddy standing nose at mailbox post base, Neet investigating other side, leads up to two cropped human hands; closed mailbox, no actual food or cat. Panel lower right: home doorstep, Heather's cropped hand moves vase of same bouquet on low porch ledge away from Buddy's interested raised nose; Buddy standing on lawn after roll, Neet separately looks toward street with ears pricked. Clear dog anatomy, attached leash hardware, grounded feet. No letters.
